title: Classify H6 dyadic Smith factors and sharp physical-row repair
body:
## Summary

For the inherited H6 complement matrix `C=I-K` over `Z[1/2]`, this derives the complete localized Smith factors `1^30400, 11^336, 209^208, 4807^16`. Its determinant has odd factors `11^560*19^224*23^16`, so rational invertibility does not make C a reversible dyadic source map.

Every unimodular dyadic repair has rank at least **560**. An explicit set of **560 actual physical row IDs**, with small exact modular certificates, proves those rows suffice for algebraic replacement while preserving the other 30,400 rows. The proof supplies existence of a primitive row completion, not its coefficients or a paid circuit. A stable unit extension needs exactly 560 auxiliary directions algebraically; its simple unit blocks mix entering helper dirt into the output and change the helper outputs.

## Scope and limits

Only `research/h6-dyadic-source-repair/` is added, with six live source files pinned to original Git objects at `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. The full spectral and sector theorem is inherited explicitly from its moment proof; the new replay does not construct the dense 30,960-square matrix or rerun a dense Smith reduction.

C is the mathematical complement `I-K`, not the current native K response. No native complement producer, legal source/output gauges, completion coefficients, basis-change tariff, dirt compensation/restoration, physical banks/copies, precision/tape or joint outer admission is supplied. Exact `(x,h)->(Cx,h)` with all arbitrary helpers restored remains impossible as a dyadic unimodular map. No new kappa, paid source circuit or selected-record change is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] Fresh source-bound determinant, reduced-annihilator and complete Smith valuation checks; named 560-row support, mixed/harmonic/radial modular minors and actual unit blocks.
- [x] Separate exact checker freshly derives all 240 harmonic, 560 mixed and 32 radial polynomial actions. Two producer matrix mutations, two arithmetic counterchecks and three independent mutations execute; inherited full spectral premises remain explicit.
- [x] Registered isolated optimized Python 3.12 replay with warnings as errors, read-only authenticated inputs and fresh external output.
- [x] Exact commit `7bf23e128e58a33c019268f57129629f603547f7`: committed-byte/source-history preflight passed for all 18 package/input files, with only ancestral `20ec` source history. Actual read-only Git-free optimized export replay passed in 1.96 seconds with every byte unchanged. `VALIDATION.json` retains earlier precommit measurements.
- [ ] Automatic exact-head hosted CI, read back after publication; no manual rerun.

## Sources and credit

Credit Dominik Scholz's [PR606](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/606) geometry/factorization, DreamingOfClouds' [H6/Walsh proposal](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167), and [PR1830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1830)'s spectral/compensation/encoder audit with its retained predecessor lineage. This uses their exact moment/sector theorem and adds the localized Smith consequences and actual row-support certificate. No priority is claimed for general Smith theory, primitive-module completion or rank-perturbation bounds.

Ross Richardson, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, separate audit and packaging; Apache-2.0. Separate AI implementations are not human review or formal-kernel verification. The package retains source pins, adaptation records, a complete scoped proof and open implementation questions.
